artifact:
Feature: GUI Ventilation Settings and Alarms

  Scenario Outline: User can adjust PEEP from 0-20 cmH2O with increments of 1
    Given the GUI is initialized
    When the user sets the PEEP to <peep_value> cmH2O
    Then the PEEP value should be set to <peep_value> cmH2O

    Examples:
      | peep_value |
      | 0          |
      | 10         |
      | 20         |
      | 21         | # Invalid value
      | -1         | # Invalid value

  Scenario Outline: GUI renders parameters and alarms readable at a distance of 1m
    Given the GUI is initialized
    When the user views the parameters and alarms from a distance of 1m
    Then the parameters and alarms should be readable

    Examples:
      | distance |
      | 1m       |

  Scenario Outline: User can adjust RR from 5-30 bpm with increments of 1
    Given the GUI is initialized
    When the user sets the RR to <rr_value> bpm
    Then the RR value should be set to <rr_value> bpm

    Examples:
      | rr_value |
      | 5        |
      | 15       |
      | 30       |
      | 31       | # Invalid value
      | 4        | # Invalid value

  Scenario Outline: User can adjust IER from 1:1 to 1:4
    Given the GUI is initialized
    When the user sets the IER to <ier_value>
    Then the IER value should be set to <ier_value>

    Examples:
      | ier_value |
      | 1:1       |
      | 1:2       |
      | 1:3       |
      | 1:4       |
      | 1:5       | # Invalid value
      | 2:1       | # Invalid value

  Scenario: GUI requires all ventilation and alarm setting changes to be confirmed
    Given the GUI is initialized
    When the user changes a ventilation or alarm setting
    Then the GUI should prompt for confirmation

  Scenario Outline: User can adjust O2 infusion (FiO2) from 0.21 to as close to 1 as possible with a minimum of 0.96, adjustable in increments of 0.1
    Given the GUI is initialized
    When the user sets the FiO2 to <fio2_value>
    Then the FiO2 value should be set to <fio2_value>

    Examples:
      | fio2_value |
      | 0.21       |
      | 0.5        |
      | 0.96       |
      | 1.0        |
      | 1.1        | # Invalid value
      | 0.20       | # Invalid value

  Scenario Outline: User can adjust HFNC flow rate from 0 to 60 L/min in increments of 5 L/min
    Given the GUI is initialized
    When the user sets the HFNC flow rate to <flow_rate> L/min
    Then the HFNC flow rate should be set to <flow_rate> L/min

    Examples:
      | flow_rate |
      | 0         |
      | 10        |
      | 60        |
      | 65        | # Invalid value
      | -5        | # Invalid value

  Scenario: GUI computes amount of leakage based on controller actuation and sensor readings
    Given the GUI is initialized
    And the controller actuation and sensor readings are available
    When the GUI computes the leakage
    Then the leakage amount should be calculated based on the controller actuation and sensor readings
